gates.claim: SHARED's w2 weight reads never exceed the group model's count
gates.threshold: q_S,w2(n) <= 1.05 x group_reads at every n, scored on both edges of SHARED's weight-only bracket, its lowest call (NATIVE pooled) less e to its highest, e PRIVATE's excess over n; UNKNOWN where the edges disagree
gates.invalidates: the model's ceiling: co-residency can only remove WEIGHT reads, never add them. An activation re-read is not a weight read, and q_S counts one as if it were: at G >= E n every live M-tile is in one group, every column pass walks them all, and where that pass outgrows the L2 the A repeats reach DRAM (up to (BM/BN)(1 - 1/num_pid_n) of W_w2 per tread). The lower edge takes them out, so only a FAIL on both edges refutes the model
